synopsis: Full northbound resupply plan for the Appalachian Trail (~2,190 mi), aligned with common thru-hiker guides (AWOL / Guthook / The Trek resupply surveys). These are the towns and trail-side stops hikers plan between—not every place near the corridor.

stops.name: Springer Mountain
stops.note: Southern terminus. Most northbounders start from Amicalola Falls Approach Trail.

stops.name: Neels Gap / Walasi-Yi
stops.note: Mountain Crossings—first outfitter, shakedown, and hot food.

stops.name: Hiawassee, GA
stops.note: First full grocery resupply for many NOBOs.

stops.name: Franklin, NC
stops.note: Outfitters, grocery, and lodging—standard early stop.

stops.name: Nantahala Outdoor Center
stops.note: River gorge rest stop—restaurant, outfitter, and mail drops.

stops.name: Hot Springs, NC
stops.note: Trail runs Main Street—hostels, restaurants, hot springs.

stops.name: Erwin, TN
stops.note: Post-Smokies resupply—grocery, motels, Nolichucky area.

stops.name: Hampton, TN / Watauga Lake
stops.note: Lake-area resupply and hiker-friendly stores.

stops.name: Damascus, VA
stops.note: Trail Town USA—Trail Days, hostels, and social hub.

stops.name: Marion, VA
stops.note: Full grocery and motels off trail.

stops.name: Atkins, VA
stops.note: Trail-side store and diner—popular short stop.

stops.name: Pearisburg, VA
stops.note: Grocery, pizza, and motels—common Virginia resupply.

stops.name: Bland, VA
stops.note: Post office, grocery, and hiker shuttle hub.

stops.name: Daleville / Catawba, VA
stops.note: Mall, grocery, and motels—easy resupply before Roanoke area.

stops.name: Waynesboro, VA
stops.note: Shenandoah gateway—full town services and outfitter.

stops.name: Front Royal, VA
stops.note: North end of Shenandoah—grocery, motels, and shuttles.

stops.name: Harpers Ferry, WV
stops.note: Psychological halfway—ATC visitor center and mail drops.

stops.name: Boiling Springs, PA
stops.note: Lake-side town with grocery and tavern.

stops.name: Duncannon, PA
stops.note: Susquehanna crossing—grocery, pizza, and motels.

stops.name: Port Clinton, PA
stops.note: Gateway to Pennsylvania rocks section.

stops.name: Palmerton, PA
stops.note: Superfund town with grocery and diner on trail.

stops.name: Delaware Water Gap, PA
stops.note: End of Pennsylvania—hostels and restaurants.

stops.name: Kent, CT
stops.note: Connecticut resupply with grocery and cafes.

stops.name: Great Barrington, MA
stops.note: Berkshires resupply—grocery and outfitter.

stops.name: Hanover, NH
stops.note: Dartmouth college town—grocery, outfitter, and zero days.

stops.name: Gorham, NH
stops.note: White Mountains gateway—motels and full grocery.

stops.name: Lincoln / Franconia, NH
stops.note: Franconia Notch area—outfitter and resupply.

stops.name: Pinkham Notch
stops.note: AMC visitor center—meals and supplies in the Whites.

stops.name: Andover, ME
stops.note: Southern Maine resupply before the big woods.

stops.name: Rangeley, ME
stops.note: Lakes region resupply and lodging.

stops.name: Caratunk, ME
stops.note: Kennet & Wynn's—river crossing and hiker services.

stops.name: Monson, ME
stops.note: Last town before the 100-Mile Wilderness—Shaw's Lodging.

stops.name: Millinocket, ME
stops.note: Katahdin gateway—motels, grocery, and Baxter shuttles.

stops.name: Mount Katahdin
stops.note: Northern terminus—Baxter State Park permit required.

synopsis: Full resupply plan for the Pacific Crest Trail (~2,650 mi), based on Yogi’s PCT Handbook, Guthook, and Halfway Anywhere resupply survey patterns. Includes desert caches, Sierra exits, and Cascades stops hikers actually use.

stops.name: Campo (Southern terminus)
stops.note: Mexico border monument—traditional start.

stops.name: Mount Laguna / Julian area
stops.note: Early desert resupply—Julian pie and Mount Laguna store.

stops.name: Warner Springs
stops.note: First major resupply—community center and trail angels.

stops.name: Idyllwild
stops.note: San Jacinto detour—outfitter, restaurants, zero days.

stops.name: Big Bear Lake
stops.note: Full-service town after desert transition.

stops.name: Wrightwood
stops.note: Mountain town resupply before the Mojave.

stops.name: Agua Dulce / Hikertown
stops.note: Desert oasis—trail angel stops and mail drops.

stops.name: Tehachapi
stops.note: Wind farm section resupply—grocery and motels.

stops.name: Kennedy Meadows (desert)
stops.note: Sierra gateway—bear canister, ice axe, and Sierra prep.

stops.name: Lone Pine / Independence
stops.note: Sierra exit for snow years or resupply before re-entry.

stops.name: Mammoth Lakes
stops.note: Reds Meadow shuttle access—major Sierra resupply.

stops.name: Tuolumne Meadows
stops.note: Yosemite high country store—check seasonal hours.

stops.name: South Lake Tahoe
stops.note: Post-Sierra resupply—grocery, lodging, trail angels.

stops.name: Truckee
stops.note: Northern Sierra resupply and outfitter.

stops.name: Sierra City
stops.note: Small town resupply before Northern California.

stops.name: Belden Town
stops.note: River resort resupply in the North Cascades approach.

stops.name: Chester
stops.note: Lake Almanor area grocery and motels.

stops.name: Burney / Burney Falls
stops.note: Falls-side resupply—grocery and trail magic.

stops.name: Castella / Dunsmuir
stops.note: I-5 corridor resupply in Shasta country.

stops.name: Etna
stops.note: Small-town resupply before Marble Mountains.

stops.name: Seiad Valley
stops.note: CA/OR border area—store and pancake challenge.

stops.name: Ashland, OR
stops.note: Oregon entry—full town services and Shakespeare town.

stops.name: Crater Lake / Mazama Village
stops.note: Store and camp—side trail to the lake.

stops.name: Cascade Locks
stops.note: Bridge of the Gods—Washington entry and brew pub.

stops.name: White Pass
stops.note: Pass store and restaurant—Washington resupply.

stops.name: Snoqualmie Pass
stops.note: Pass-area store before North Cascades.

stops.name: Stehekin
stops.note: Boat-in town—bakery and resupply; plan ferry schedule.

stops.name: Northern terminus (Canada)
stops.note: Finish at the Canadian border.

stops.name: Scissors Crossing
stops.note: Critical desert cache—long carry to Warner Springs.

stops.name: Crabtree Meadows
stops.note: Last easy water before high Sierra.

synopsis: Full resupply plan for the Continental Divide Trail (~3,100 mi), based on Yogi’s CDT Handbook and common thru-hiker mail-drop patterns. Spaced for typical 4–7 day carries in remote country.

stops.name: Crazy Cook Monument
stops.note: Southern terminus—shuttles from Lordsburg.

stops.name: Lordsburg, NM
stops.note: Bootheel shuttle hub—motels and grocery.

stops.name: Silver City, NM
stops.note: Major early resupply before/after Gila alternates.

stops.name: Reserve, NM
stops.note: Catron County resupply after Gila section.

stops.name: Pie Town, NM
stops.note: Legendary pie cafe—CDT culture stop.

stops.name: Grants, NM
stops.note: Full grocery and motels on I-40 corridor.

stops.name: Chama, NM
stops.note: Colorado border town before San Juan Mountains.

stops.name: Pagosa Springs, CO
stops.note: Hot springs town—resupply after San Juans.

stops.name: Salida, CO
stops.note: Arkansas River resupply and outfitter.

stops.name: Leadville, CO
stops.note: Highest city in the U.S.—full resupply.

stops.name: Twin Lakes, CO
stops.note: Resupply store before Collegiate Peaks.

stops.name: Copper Mountain / Frisco
stops.note: Summit County resupply—grocery and outfitter.

stops.name: Steamboat Springs, CO
stops.note: Ski town resupply in northern Colorado.

stops.name: Rawlins, WY
stops.note: Great Divide Basin gateway—long water carries ahead.

stops.name: South Pass City / Lander
stops.note: Basin exit resupply—Lander has full services.

stops.name: Pinedale, WY
stops.note: Wind River Range resupply and outfitter.

stops.name: Yellowstone NP (Old Faithful)
stops.note: In-park store—plan for NP miles and regulations.

stops.name: Helena, MT
stops.note: Montana capital—full resupply and outfitter.

stops.name: Butte, MT
stops.note: Historic mining town—grocery and motels.

stops.name: Anaconda, MT
stops.note: Resupply before Bob Marshall / Glacier approach.

stops.name: Lincoln, MT
stops.note: Scenic resupply town in western Montana.

stops.name: East Glacier, MT
stops.note: Glacier NP gateway—last major resupply.

stops.name: Waterton–Glacier terminus
stops.note: Northern terminus at Canada border.

stops.name: Bootheel water caches
stops.note: Dry bootheel—check CDT water report and trail angels.
